database.sqlite_note: SQLite is supported with limited concurrent write safety and no row-lock capability.

boot_install.gate: Every configured v2 operator model resolves to a readable table.
boot_install.unready_behavior: auto resolves to v1; v2 pinned remains resolved to v2 but uses_v2=false and Waterline returns 503.

claim.gate: The task queue connection satisfies the backend capability snapshot at claim time.
claim.unready_behavior: The task remains ready, claim failure metadata is persisted, and repair backoff is scheduled.

dispatch.gate: No database, queue, codec, or structural-limit issue has error severity; cache issues remain non-blocking warnings.
dispatch.unready_behavior: Task dispatch does not claim unsupported durable work; operators see backend_capabilities errors.

health.gate: Waterline is actively using v2, then HealthCheck decides ok, warning, or error from backend and projection checks.
health.unready_behavior: GET /waterline/api/v2/health returns 503 when Waterline is not actively using v2.

stats.gate: Waterline is actively using v2 before v2 operator_metrics are trusted.
stats.unready_behavior: Legacy stats stay available for auto/v1; v2 pinned and unavailable returns 503 with engine_source diagnostics.

hybrid_migration_view.message: Waterline can show preserved finish-on-v1 workflows beside v2 runs.

issues.message: SQLite serializes writes; high pending-count limits may cause lock contention under concurrent worker load.
